zh: 密码不合法只可能是出现了长度达到 k 的同字母连续段；换句话说，只要每一段连续相同字母的长度都在 1..k−1 之间就合法。
设 d[i] 为长度 i 的合法密码数，按最后一段同字母连续段的长度 L（1..k−1）分类：前面 i−L 个字符是任意一个合法密码，最后一段要换成与之不同的字母，有 25 种选择；若整串只有一段（L=i），则有 26 种。
d[1]=26；i 从 2 到 n，用滑动窗口维护最近 k−1 个 d 值之和（加入 d[i−1]，移出 d[i−k]），d[i] 等于 25 乘以窗口和，当 i<k 时再加 26；全程对 1000000007 取模，减法后要加回模数，答案是 d[n]。
en: A password is invalid only when some run of identical letters reaches length k; in other words, it is valid exactly when every run of identical letters has length between 1 and k-1.

Let d[i] be the number of valid passwords of length i and classify them by the length L (1..k-1) of the final run: the first i-L characters form any valid password and the final run uses a different letter, 25 choices; if the whole string is one run (L = i) there are 26 choices.

Set d[1] = 26; for i from 2 to n keep a sliding-window sum of the last k-1 values of d (add d[i-1], remove d[i-k]); d[i] is 25 times the window sum, plus 26 when i < k. Reduce modulo 1000000007 throughout, add the modulus back after subtracting, and output d[n].

explanationEn:
## Approach

Keep the source constraint k<=n; boundary tests cover k=2 and k=n.

## Proof of correctness

Classify strings by the length of their trailing run of identical characters. Appending a different character has 25 choices; appending the same character extends the old trailing run by 1. Summing over the classes gives 25 times the sum of the most recent at most k-1 length states; the rolling window only speeds up that sum and is equivalent to an independent DP over the trailing-run length.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
